book.name: 1 Timoteo
book.title: Pablo nagkamchaku carta agaja Timoteo awetimu

content: Dekatkauk ju aidau dutikatajum tajime, segatajum, Apajuishkam ausatajum, mijattsuk segakjum, ashí aents aina nu pachisjum Apajuí see titajum,
nuniakjum rey aidau nuigtú ashí apu aidau pachisjumesh Apajuí aujtustajum, shiig agkan, tutitag atsamunum ashí Apajuí puyatjusa umijuinaku imagnisa batsamsagmi tusajum.
Wagki juuwai pegkeja duka, nuigtú iina Apajuiji Uwemtikagtina nunash shiig awagma duka,
nunin asa nigka ashí aents uwemjatnume, nunikag dekaatnume dekaskea nuna tusa wakegawai.
Wagki makichik Apajuik awai, nunisag Apajuijai chichaman epegtugbaush makichki, duka Cristo Jesusai aentsmagauwa nunú,
nunin asa nigki tsagkamankauwai ashí aentsun agkanmitkata tau asa; nunak, nuniktinji tsawan jegamtai Apajuí iwaintugmakui.
Nuadui chichagkagtin nuigtú apóstol emamuitjai, (nunak Cristo daajin waitjutsuk tajai) Apajuí minak judiochu aina nuna maestroji etiuwai dekaskenum dekaskeapi tuta nuna jintintuati tusa.
Nuadui, ashí yantamnum aishmag aidauk pegkejam anentaiyai, kajegdaitsuk nuigtush jiyanitsuk, uwejin nayaimpinum takuidiag Apajuí aujsatnume tusan wakegajai.

Nunisag nuwa aidaushkam, jaanchjish ajantsá diyam amainun nugkugtinme, datsan amainchaun nuigtú pegkeg iwagmamja iwainmamkata tachamui, wakejumainun temashmatsuk, oro, kaya perla nuigtú jaanch akik aina ibaujai iwagmamtsuk,
ayatak pegkeg aina nunak takainak, iwainmamkatnume nuwa Apajuí puyatjus umignush wajukuita nuna.
Nuwak takamtak unuimagti, ashí nu aina nuig sumimak,
nuwanak jintinkagtuati tatsujai, aishmagku wagagkig nunikta tumaitsui, takamtak atinme.
Apajuik dekatkauk Adagkan najana dui Evan najanauwai;
nuigtush Adagkak tsanuamak asachui, nuwa tsanuam asauwai, dutika tsanujam tudaun takasui.
Tujash nuwak uchí uchigmau asa, ebetmamag dekaskeapi tusa, anenka takaak, pegké pujak uwemjattawai.
